source_citation: Texas A&M AgriLife Plants of Texas Rangelands

morphology_source_reported.habit: Shrub or small tree to 7.6 m
morphology_source_reported.leaves: Bipinnate, 2–5 pairs of pinnae with 3–8 pairs of oblong blue-green leaflets
morphology_source_reported.flowers: Bright yellow globose heads 2.5–3 cm diameter
morphology_source_reported.fruit: Thin pods 10–25 cm long, green then brown, numerous seeds

flowering_source_reported: Spring to October intermittently after rain
